dp-brand-catalog-360.description: PXM hub that materializes UCP Product + Variant GIDs so SPANX, Zyliss, Pura, and NaturVet share one catalog identity across marketplaces and Google AI surfaces.
dp-brand-catalog-360.name: Brand Catalog 360

dp-pattern-intelligence.description: 90+ live sensors over UCP Product, Checkout, Order, and Fulfillment — 160+ diagnostics on 91T+ data points.
dp-pattern-intelligence.name: Pattern Intelligence

dp-cdp-google-checkout.description: Consumer-aligned checkout sessions for Search / Gemini — line_items.item.id is UCP Variant GID.
dp-cdp-google-checkout.name: Google UCP Checkout

concept-product.description: UCP Product — Global ID (GID) uniquely identifying a sellable product (title, description, url, categories, price_range, variants).
concept-product.name: Product

concept-variant.description: UCP Variant — purchasable SKU of a Product. GID is used as item.id in checkout; sku and barcodes correlate across marketplaces.
concept-variant.name: Variant

concept-line-item.description: UCP Line Item — item (Variant GID) + quantity + totals on a Cart or Checkout.
concept-line-item.name: LineItem

concept-cart.description: UCP Cart — pre-checkout basket with line_items, currency, and estimated totals.
concept-cart.name: Cart

concept-checkout.description: UCP Checkout session — native checkout on Google AI surfaces (create / update / complete). Status lifecycle incomplete → completed.
concept-checkout.name: Checkout

concept-order.description: UCP Order — post-purchase record bound to checkout_id, line_items, fulfillment, and totals (GMV source).
concept-order.name: Order

concept-fulfillment.description: UCP Fulfillment — buyer expectations and what actually shipped (methods, destinations, events).
concept-fulfillment.name: Fulfillment

concept-buyer.description: UCP Buyer — first_name, last_name, email, phone. Guest checkout default; identity linking optional.
concept-buyer.name: Buyer

concept-payment-handler.description: UCP Payment Handler — processor (e.g. Google Pay) separate from the buyer instrument.
concept-payment-handler.name: PaymentHandler

concept-merchant-profile.description: UCP profile published at /.well-known/ucp — services, capabilities (checkout, fulfillment, discount, order), and payment handlers.
concept-merchant-profile.name: MerchantProfile

concept-attribution.description: UCP Attribution — platform-emitted campaign, click, and source/medium context on Cart/Checkout.
concept-attribution.name: Attribution

concept-brand.description: Pattern overlay: a brand Pattern accelerates (SPANX, Zyliss, Pura, NaturVet). Maps to UCP Product seller / metadata — not a second product identity.
concept-brand.name: Brand

concept-gmc-offer.description: Google Merchant Center offer_id from the shopping feed used for UCP discovery on Search and Gemini. sameAs UCP Variant GID.
concept-gmc-offer.name: MerchantCenterOffer

ns-ucp.description: Canonical shopping namespace — Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP). Pattern global and every marketplace federate here, the way NATCOs federate to TM Forum SID Customer.
ns-ucp.name: ucp.shopping

ns-pattern.description: Pattern enterprise overlay on UCP — Brand, PXM, Pi sensors. Does not fork Product/Variant meaning.
ns-pattern.name: pattern-global

ossie-pattern-ucp-shopping.description: Apache Ossie interchange for UDP-Pattern. SDP marketplace listings feed ADP Product/Variant; CDP checkout_session serves Google native checkout.
ossie-pattern-ucp-shopping.name: ucp_shopping

col-product-gid.description: UCP Product.id (GID). Canonical key for catalog, ads, social, and Pi.
col-product-gid.name: product_gid

col-variant-gid.description: UCP Variant.id (GID). Used as item.id on Cart and Checkout line items.
col-variant-gid.name: variant_gid

col-offer-id.description: Merchant Center offer identifier — federates to UCP Variant GID.
col-offer-id.name: offer_id

sys-pattern-platform.description: Pi + Destiny analytics over UCP Product, Order, and Fulfillment.
sys-pattern-platform.name: Pattern Intelligence Platform

sys-merchant-center.description: Product feed + shipping/returns config that enables UCP discovery on Google AI surfaces (Search, Gemini).
sys-merchant-center.name: Google Merchant Center

sys-google-pay.description: UCP payment handler — Google Wallet credentials on native checkout.
sys-google-pay.name: Google Pay

tbl-product-360.name: ucp.product_360
